title: Why your body reacts before you can think
content: There's a fast brain pathway that can trigger a physical reaction, racing heart, tension, the urge to flee or fight, before the slower, more thoughtful part of your brain has finished processing what happened. That's why a reaction can feel like it's happening before you've consciously decided anything: the body's alarm system is built to act first and think later, because that used to matter for survival.
